title: InjectedHit
description: One semantic code hit rendered into a coding job's `Semantic code context` section, with the provenance required to judge whether it can be trusted.

file_path.description: Repository-relative, normalized path. Never absolute and never containing a '..' segment — a rendered section invites the worker to open these files, so a path that escapes the repository is a scope claim this contract must be unable to make. The pattern enforces both, rather than only describing them.

start_line.description: First line of the excerpt, 1-based and inclusive.

end_line.description: Last line of the excerpt, 1-based and inclusive. Never less than start_line.

score.description: Relevance. Carries ri-03's `CodeSearchHit.similarity` value under the roadmap's name.

indexed_commit.description: Full Git object ID the serving index was built from. Carries ri-03's `CodeSearchHit.source_revision`. Equals the requested revision, because a mismatch is a fallback rather than an injection.

index_id.description: Identity of the index that served this hit. `format` is an annotation that validators ignore unless a format checker is installed, so the shape is pinned by `pattern` as well — otherwise any string would pass and the serving index would stop being identifiable.

scope_decision.description: Always `allowed`. A hit failing the local deny re-check is omitted with reason `scope_filtered`, never rendered with a downgraded decision.

language.description: Language label, used to pick the fenced-code info string.

content.description: The excerpt verbatim. Never truncated: an over-long hit is omitted with reason `hit_line_cap` so the rendered line range is always true.
